import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
iris = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set the style for the plot
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a pairplot to visualize the relationships between features colored by species
pairplot = sns.pairplot(iris, hue='species', markers=["o", "s", "D"], palette='Set2')

# Set the title
pairplot.fig.suptitle('Iris Flower Species Pairplot', y=1.02)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
